cards.answer: Jax is a fighter who leaps onto targets and gains attack speed through repeated basic attacks. His abilities combine physical and magic damage with AD and AP scaling.
cards.counterplay: Limit extended trades and create distance during Counter Strike.

citations.quote: Name: Jax. Official role tags: Fighter.
Jax leaps toward a unit.
Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

facts.claim: Jax is a fighter who leaps onto targets and gains attack speed through repeated basic attacks.

citations.quote: Physical Damage:65 / 105 / 145 / 185 / 225 (+ 100% bonus AD)
Additional Magic Damage:50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 (+ 60% AP)

facts.claim: His abilities combine physical and magic damage with AD and AP scaling.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing his sustained attack pattern and defensive stun is central to fighting him.

cards.answer: Relentless Assault grants stacking bonus attack speed as Jax basic attacks. Continued attacks refresh the stacks; after he stops attacking, they eventually expire gradually.
cards.counterplay: Break contact to let his attack speed stacks fade before trading again.

citations.quote: Jax's basic attacks generate stacks, up to a cap.
For each stack, Jax gains bonus attack speed.

facts.claim: Relentless Assault grants stacking bonus attack speed as Jax basic attacks.

citations.quote: refreshing on subsequent attacks
Stacks expire one by one every 0.25 seconds when the duration ends.

facts.claim: Continued attacks refresh the stacks; after he stops attacking, they eventually expire gradually.

cards.priority_reason: Explains why uninterrupted attacks make extended trades more threatening.

cards.answer: Leap Strike dashes Jax to a target unit's location. If the target is an enemy in range when he arrives, he deals physical damage. He can cast his other abilities during the dash.
cards.counterplay: Respect his ability to close distance and combine the leap with other abilities.

citations.quote: Active: Jax dashes to the target unit's location.

facts.claim: Leap Strike dashes Jax to a target unit's location.

citations.quote: If the target is an enemy and they are in range upon arrival, Jax deals physical damage to them.

facts.claim: If the target is an enemy in range when he arrives, he deals physical damage.

citations.quote: Jax can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

facts.claim: He can cast his other abilities during the dash.

cards.priority_reason: His targeted gap closer determines when he can reach an enemy.

cards.answer: Empower adds magic damage to Jax's next basic attack or Leap Strike against an enemy. It resets his basic attack timer, and an empowered basic attack gains extra range.
cards.counterplay: Keep space after his attacks and respect an empowered follow-up or leap.

citations.quote: Active: Jax empowers his next basic attack or Leap Strike against an enemy to deal additional magic damage.

facts.claim: Empower adds magic damage to Jax's next basic attack or Leap Strike against an enemy.

citations.quote: Empower resets Jax's basic attack timer.
If Empower is used on a basic attack, it will gain 50 bonus range and have an uncancellable windup.

facts.claim: It resets his basic attack timer, and an empowered basic attack gains extra range.

cards.priority_reason: Explains his quick follow-up damage and empowered leap threat.

cards.answer: Counter Strike temporarily dodges non-turret basic attacks and reduces damage from champion area abilities. It ends with magic damage and a stun around Jax; dodging attacks increases its damage. He can recast it early after a delay.
cards.counterplay: Avoid attacking into his dodge and move away before the stun; account for an early recast.

citations.quote: a defensive stance that causes him to dodge all incoming non- turret basic attacks and take reduced damage from all area of effect abilities from champions.

facts.claim: Counter Strike temporarily dodges non-turret basic attacks and reduces damage from champion area abilities.

citations.quote: Recast: Jax deals magic damage and stuns nearby enemies, the damage is increased if he dodged more attacks.
Counter Strike can be recast within this time, and does so automatically after the duration.

facts.claim: It ends with magic damage and a stun around Jax; dodging attacks increases its damage.

citations.quote: Counter Strike can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.

facts.claim: He can recast it early after a delay.

cards.priority_reason: His attack dodge and nearby stun create his main defensive and engagement window.

cards.answer: Grandmaster-at-Arms passively adds magic damage to every third consecutive basic attack. Its active deals magic damage around Jax; hitting a champion grants temporary armor and magic resistance, increasing with additional champions hit. While active, its bonus attack damage triggers more frequently.
cards.counterplay: Spread out around his active swing and limit extended trades while his resistances are active.

citations.quote: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage.

facts.claim: Grandmaster-at-Arms passively adds magic damage to every third consecutive basic attack.

citations.quote: Active: Jax swings his lantern around, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.
If this hits a champion, he gains bonus armor, increased for each champion hit beyond the first, and bonus magic resistance equal to 60% of that amount as well as 10% increased size for 8 seconds.

facts.claim: Its active deals magic damage around Jax; hitting a champion grants temporary armor and magic resistance, increasing with additional champions hit.

citations.quote: He applies his passive on-hit every 2 stacks instead of every 3 while active.

facts.claim: While active, its bonus attack damage triggers more frequently.

cards.priority_reason: The active combines nearby damage, conditional durability, and stronger sustained attacks.
